errors.text: The proposed removal of Mo does not reconstruct the target intervention, which is addition of 4.2 at.% Cr and formation of approximately 4 vol.% reticulated Laves phase.

The cited evidence explicitly indicates that the Mo-free HfNbTaTiZr alloy has poor elevated-temperature yield strength, contradicting the central claim that Mo removal preserves properties near 1000 °C.
The hypothesis omits the target's morphology-dependent toughening mechanism and provides no evidence that generic lattice distortion after Mo removal can preserve both strength and fracture strain.
No meaningful loading or microstructural applicability boundaries are defined.
